explication: MOSS-TTS Family is an open-source model suite for speech and sound generation. Its principal workflow is a user submitting text (optionally with reference audio or voice/style instructions) through a model-specific entry point and receiving generated speech or sound; realtime variants stream audio as text arrives. The repository also includes local/llama.cpp inference options and fine-tuning paths. README capabilities guide the overall map; sampled source confirms selected inference and streaming details, so unsampled subsystem wiring is kept conservative.
